@kbench.task(name="social_reciprocity_11")
def social_reciprocity_11():
    """Understand reciprocity norms."""
    prompt = """You give a coworker a ride home. Later, they buy you lunch.

This demonstrates:

A) Bribery
B) Reciprocity norm
C) Random act
D) Debt obligation"""
    return prompt, "B"
